entries.EN:
The FN F2000 is a 5.56x45mm NATO bullpup rifle, designed by FN Herstal in Belgium. Its compact bullpup design includes a telescopic sight, a non-adjustable fixed notch and front blade secondary sight. The weapon has fully ambidextrous controls, allowed by a unique ejection system, ejecting spent cartridge casings forward and to the right side of the weapon, through a tube running above the barrel.
 

		%c[0,255,255,255]PROPERTIES:

		%c[0,255,255,255] • Origin: %c[0,170,170,170]Belgium

		%c[0,255,255,255] • Manufacturer: %c[0,170,170,170]FN Herstal
entries.JA_current:
FN F2000はFN Herstalがベルギーで開発した、5.56×45mm NATO弾を使用するブルパップ方式のライフル。コンパクトな設計に望遠照準器、固定式の切り欠き照準器、予備のフロントサイトを組み込んでいる。独自の排莢機構により、左右どちらの手でも操作できる。使用済み薬莢は銃身の上を通る排莢筒を通り、銃の右前方へ排出される。

Based on the AR-15, the LR-300 is an excellent weapon system suitable for military use in close quarters battle. entries.EN:
Engineered for Soviet special operations units, the AS Val is a gas operated, integrally suppressed weapon that was set to supersede the AK-47 and AKM rifles. It is easily disassembled and concealed and is lightweight and comfortable to fire with the suppressor reducing bullet velocity to below subsonic levels. Today, the AS VAL sees widespread use among Russian special forces.

A legendary bolt-action, internal magazine-fed rifle, developed in the late 1800s and used by the armed forces of the Russian Empire, the Soviet Union, and various other nations. It is one of the most mass-produced military bolt-action rifles in history and is known for its reliability, accuracy, and durability in harsh conditions. It is still used by some irregular forces and civilian shooters today.

entries.EN:
A shoulder-fired, break-action, single shot grenade launcher first appearing during the Vietnam War. Recoil is kept low by means of a 'High-Low Propulsion System' where propellant is stored in a high-pressure chamber, allowing much larger projectiles to be launched without the heavy equipment usually needed. When the propellant is ignited, the gases are bled out through vents at reduced pressure to a much larger, low-pressure chamber to push the projectile forward. The high-low system allows the weight of the weapon and its ammunition to be reduced significantly.
 

		%c[0,255,255,255]PROPERTIES:

		%c[0,255,255,255] • Origin: %c[0,170,170,170]United States

		%c[0,255,255,255] • Manufacturer: %c[0,170,170,170]Springfield Armory
